in_sanskrit.name: Ajithkumar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Never Retreat
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajithkumar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ajith: Never retreat, unconquerable, invincible. Kumar: Son of. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'ajitam' which means 'unconquerable'. In Hindu mythology, Ajith is the name of several gods and heroes, symbolizing courage, strength, and determination.
